consent.title: Before you start
consent.lead: When you ask a question, JoyoRogo sends this data to the AI provider so the answer can use your data:

data.body: Your age, sex, height, and goal
data.food: Your food log: the name, weight, and nutrition of each food
data.weight: Your weight history and your targets
data.fasting: Your fasting status, if you fast
data.chat: The messages you type in this conversation

consent.where: Through the JoyoRogo server to Cloudflare Workers AI, only to answer your question. Messages and answers are not stored on our server and are not used to train models.
consent.notSent: Your name, email, photos, location, menstrual cycle data, pregnancy or breastfeeding mode, Strava, and device IDs.
consent.adults: By agreeing, you confirm you are 18 or older. Answers can be wrong and are not medical advice.
consent.privacy: Read more on the Privacy page
